question: Which of the following Indian classical dance forms uses various colours on face to symbolise the characters?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathakali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kathakali is a classical Indian dance form that is a story-play genre of art and is the folk dance form of Kerala.
 
• It is a combination of 5 forms of fine art which are –
 
 
• Natyam (expressions)
 
• Nritham (dance)
 
• Nrithyam (enactment) 
 
• Sangeetam (music)
 
• Vadya (instruments)
 
 
 
• Various costumes of characters of Kathakali –
 
 
• Sathwika (Hero)
 
• Katti (Villain)
 
• Minukku (females)
 
• Thathi (other characters)​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The Sangeet Natak Akademi recognizes eight classical dances in India.
